text_blocks.snippet: To visit the U.S., foreign nationals generally need a visa unless they qualify for the Visa Waiver Program (VWP). For those requiring a visa, the type (immigrant or nonimmigrant) depends on the purpose of travel. Nonimmigrant visas, like the B-1 (business) or B-2 (tourist) visa, are for temporary stays.
